pick.headline: British ambassador assassinated in The Hague
pick.summary: On 22 March 1979 Sir Richard Sykes, Britain's ambassador to the Netherlands, was shot dead outside his residence in The Hague by the IRA.
pick.significance: The killing was one of a series of IRA attacks on British targets abroad in 1979.
